purpose: Prepare a future-only preregistration contrast between a proposed 4 percentage point held-band candidate and a 2 percentage point control. This document is not an experiment registration or approval.

known_context.v1_status: All v1 results are already known. V1 is retrospective and point-in-time (PIT) status is unverified.
known_context.archive_and_historical_sha_checks: Preserve the v1 source, archived preregistration, results, manifest, and their historical SHA checks unchanged. Do not regenerate or rewrite v1 evidence.

future_contrast.scope: Future observations only, after an approved registration fixes the data, period, evaluation boundaries, candidate requirements, and budgets.

governance.required_return_rule: Fix a candidate-specific required-return metric, value, and horizon before any run. Missing or failed requirements block progression.
governance.v1_parameters_reuse: Do not copy v1 costs, limits, or other execution parameters as newly approved parameters. Any future values require independent justification and approval before execution.

execution_exclusions: No PAPER configuration or state change
No runner configuration or state change
No historical v1 rerun or retuning
blockers: No held-band-compatible new observations after 2026-09-08 were found; a future-only comparison cannot start until eligible observations exist and their source, universe, grade, period, and exposure status are established.
The validation and one-time untouched OOS boundaries and minimum sample are unset.
Candidate-specific required return and compute, data, artifact, and evaluation budgets are unset.
Final code, policy, and data manifest hashes do not exist for a future registered run.
reopen_conditions: New held-band-compatible observations exist strictly after 2026-09-08, and their provenance, data grade, universe, period, and exposure status can be verified without backfilling current candidates into history.
A separate registration review fixes bounded IS, separate validation, chronological walk-forward, one-time untouched OOS boundaries, and a defensible minimum sample.
Each candidate's required-return metric, value, and horizon and all compute, data, artifact, and evaluation budgets are fixed before execution.
Final code, policy, and data manifest hashes are recorded and checked, and a separate explicit approval authorizes any execution.
